## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Onyx Contract

- [ ] New or changed endpoints match a documented or source-verified Onyx contract.
- [ ] Permission and side-effect requirements are documented.
- [ ] Tool annotations describe read, write, destructive, and open-world behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Tests cover behavior and safety boundaries.
- [ ] No tokens, credentials, or private document content are included.
